item.title: Elevated errors affecting the Google Docs connector
item.description:
Nov 18, 01:44 UTC
Resolved - The issue affecting editing documents with the Google Docs connector on claude.ai, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork has been resolved. Impact occurred from 16:19 PT on November 17 / 00:19 UTC on November 18 to 17:33 PT on November 17 / 01:33 UTC on November 18.

Nov 18, 01:40 UTC
Monitoring - A fix has been deployed for the issue affecting editing documents with the Google Docs connector on claude.ai, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork, and we are monitoring for recovery.

Nov 18, 01:13 UTC
Investigating - We are investigating elevated errors when editing documents with the Google Docs connector on claude.ai, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork. Reading documents is not affected. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

item.title: Some users unable to sign in with Apple on claude.ai and the Claude iOS app
item.description:
Nov 17, 21:51 UTC
Resolved - The issue affecting Sign in with Apple on claude.ai and the Claude iOS app has been resolved. Impact occurred from 08:40 PT / 16:40 UTC to 12:20 PT / 20:20 UTC.

Nov 17, 18:56 UTC
Update - We have identified the cause of the issue affecting claude.ai and are working on a fix. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

Nov 17, 18:55 UTC
Identified - We are investigating an issue with Sign in with Apple on claude.ai and the Claude iOS app. Sign in with Google and email are not affected. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

item.title: Some users unable to sign up with Apple on the Claude iOS app
item.description:
Nov 16, 19:52 UTC
Resolved - The issue affecting Sign in with Apple on the Claude iOS app has been resolved. Impact occurred from 16:29 PT on November 13 / 00:29 UTC on November 14 to 10:31 PT / 18:31 UTC on November 16.

Nov 14, 20:12 UTC
Update - We are continuing to investigate an issue with Sign in with Apple on the Claude iOS app, which is mainly affecting new accounts. New users can sign up with Google or email instead. We will provide another update as soon as possible.

Nov 14, 07:11 UTC
Investigating - We are investigating an issue with Sign in with Apple on the Claude iOS app, which is mainly affecting new accounts. New users can sign up with Google or email instead. We will provide an update as soon as possible.
